narrative.overview: Office Ledger is a confident, high-contrast operations workspace for running a working day across people, work and approvals.
keyCharacteristics: A cool white workspace with a deep navy navigation rail.
Teal marks primary action, focus and selected work without becoming decoration.
Compact rounded controls and clear card edges keep daily work dense but legible.
Tabular figures everywhere numbers are compared.

rules.name: The One Region Rule
rules.body: Navy Rail is the navigation rail and nothing else; it never fills content.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Teal marks something that can be done; it is never decoration or a state.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Numbers use tabular figures globally so columns align.

dos: Do keep one teal primary action per work area.
Do carry state in a label or shape as well as colour.
Do use tabular figures for all comparable numbers.
donts: Don't use gradients, blur or glass on surfaces.
Don't fill content regions with Navy Rail or use teal as decoration.
Don't build dark-mode variants without revisiting contrast on the rail and teal.
